description: Phase 2 - German-origin table and field codes (VBAK, KNA1, KUNNR, MATNR...). This pack is a placeholder; enabling it currently changes nothing.
join_notes: VBELN and BELNR are each reused across document families (order/delivery/billing; FI/logistics/PO history), so they also make VBAK<->LIKP<->VBRK and BSEG<->RSEG adjacent on numbers drawn from different ranges. They stay keys because header-to-item is otherwise unreachable; the accurate cross-document links (LIPS.VGBEL, VBRP.AUBEL, VBFA.VBELV) need join_synonyms. MATNR, KUNNR and LIFNR are qualifiers, not keys: each sits on hundreds of tables, so as keys they would join two fact tables on a shared dimension and inflate sums.
